paras.text: 101. Hetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo hetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Tīṇi. Nahetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo nahetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Tīṇi. Hetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto ca nahetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto ca dhammā hetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati. Tīṇi. (Ārammaṇādhipatiyeva.) -pa-.

102. Hetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo hetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo. Nava. Āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Nava.
103. Nahetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo nahetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Tīṇi.
104. Hetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo hetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo. Nava -pa-. Avigatapaccayena paccayo. Nava.

105. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, vipāke nava, āhāre tīṇi, indriye nava, jhāne tīṇi, magge nava, sampayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava. (Anulomaṁ.)

106. Hetu adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo hetussa adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Saṁkhittaṁ.)

107. Nahetuyā nava, na-ārammaṇe nava. (Saṁkhittaṁ. Paccanīyaṁ.) Hetupaccayā na-ārammaṇe tīṇi. (Saṁkhittaṁ. Anulomapaccanīyaṁ.) Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe nava. (Saṁkhittaṁ. Paccanīyānulomaṁ.)
